data.title: Tenofovir & emtricitabine (NRTIs)
data.summary: Antivirals & ART · Tenofovir: nucleotide reverse transcriptase inhibitor (TDF / TAF); emtricitabine: cytidine NRTI (like lamivudine)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antivirals & ART_

**Class:** Tenofovir: nucleotide reverse transcriptase inhibitor (TDF / TAF); emtricitabine: cytidine NRTI (like lamivudine)

## Mechanism of action
- Tenofovir (adenosine nucleotide analogue) needs only two phosphorylation steps → tenofovir diphosphate terminates HIV DNA chains; also active against hepatitis B
- Emtricitabine (FTC) is a fluorinated lamivudine analogue — interchangeable with lamivudine in regimens (never together)

## Pharmacokinetics
- TDF (disoproxil fumarate) gives high plasma tenofovir; TAF (alafenamide) concentrates inside cells → lower plasma levels, less kidney and bone toxicity
- Renal excretion

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Backbone of preferred first-line ART in India: TLD = tenofovir 300 mg + lamivudine 300 mg + dolutegravir 50 mg once daily
- Post-exposure prophylaxis (TLD for 28 days)
- Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP): TDF + FTC (or TDF + 3TC) daily for people at high risk
- Chronic hepatitis B (TDF/TAF), including HIV–HBV co-infection

## Dose & formulations
- TDF 300 mg once daily (in FDC); TAF 25 mg; emtricitabine 200 mg once daily

## Adverse effects
- TDF: nephrotoxicity (proximal tubulopathy — Fanconi syndrome, falling GFR), reduced bone mineral density
- GI upset, headache; lactic acidosis (class, rare)
- Hepatitis B flare on stopping
- Emtricitabine: palmoplantar hyperpigmentation (especially in dark skin)

## Contraindications
- TDF: creatinine clearance below 50 mL/min (avoid/adjust) — use abacavir or TAF

## Drug interactions
- Other nephrotoxic drugs (aminoglycosides, amphotericin B, cidofovir, high-dose NSAIDs)
- Didanosine levels rise (avoid)

## Monitoring
- Creatinine/eGFR, urine dipstick (protein, glucose) at baseline and periodically; HBsAg before starting

## Pregnancy & lactation
TDF-based TLD is the recommended regimen in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

## Viva points
- TLD = preferred first-line in India
- TDF → kidney and bone; TAF is safer
- Emtricitabine → palmoplantar hyperpigmentation
- Also treats hepatitis B — stopping can cause a flare

_Sources: Khopkar ch.4 (Tenofovir, Emtricitabine); Wolverton 4e ch.11; current NACO ART guidelines. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
